# Creating a compute machine set on {{ ibm_power_server_title }} {#creating-machineset-ibm-power-vs}

Create compute machine sets in your OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_name }} to perform specific tasks. For example, you might create infrastructure machine sets and related machines so that you can move supporting workloads to the new machines. Moving supporting workloads to dedicated machines helps ensure that your cluster resources are allocated efficiently.
